editorial_summary.overview: Soup dumplings star at this budget-friendly Shanghainese eatery, along with noodle soup & dim sum.

name: Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings - Flushing

reviews.text:
In the heart of Flushing, Queens, amidst the vibrant tapestry of New York’s culinary scene, Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings stands as a testament to the enduring allure of authentic Shanghainese cuisine. This establishment, renowned for its xiao long bao, offers a dining experience that is both unpretentious and profoundly satisfying.

The soup dumplings here are nothing short of exemplary. Each delicate pouch encases a rich, flavorful broth and tender filling, striking a harmonious balance that few can replicate. The craftsmanship is evident; the dumplings boast a thin, resilient wrapper that holds the savory elixir within—a clear indication of meticulous preparation and respect for tradition.

Beyond the dumplings, the menu unfolds a variety of dishes that echo the comforting flavors of Shanghai. The Braised Beef Noodle Soup, with its tender cuts of beef and robust broth, offers a warmth that resonates deeply, especially on a brisk New York day. The Pan-Fried Pork Buns present a delightful contrast of textures, with a crispy exterior giving way to a juicy center, embodying the essence of comfort food.

The ambiance of Nan Xiang is straightforward and inviting, allowing the food to rightfully claim the spotlight. Service is efficient, reflecting a keen understanding of the restaurant’s rhythm and the expectations of its patrons. It’s a place where the focus remains steadfastly on delivering culinary authenticity without unnecessary embellishment.

In a city teeming with dining options, Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings distinguishes itself by staying true to its roots. It offers an honest, flavorful experience that resonates with both the seasoned connoisseur and the curious newcomer. For those seeking a genuine taste of Shanghai in the midst of Queens, this establishment is a destination worth exploring.

I absolutely love this place for soup dumplings! Their chicken soup dumplings are truly a standout—without a doubt the best I’ve ever tasted. I’d happily give them 4.5 stars!

The rest of the menu is fantastic, too, offering a delightful variety of dishes. I suggest arriving early since it’s so popular, but the wait is just around 20 minutes, which is quite manageable.

Everything is freshly made to order, ensuring a delicious experience. The atmosphere is lively and buzzing, but it still feels comfortable enough to enjoy your meal. Overall, it’s a wonderful dining experience that I always look forward to. Plus, the prices are quite reasonable, making it accessible for everyone. I can't recommend this spot enough!

Food - Amazing and fresh. Recommend the three treasures soup dumplings and pan fried pork buns. The red bean puff isn’t sweet which is great. Would not recommend the scallion pancake as it’s fried and pretty greasy.

Service- Excellent and swift through ordering via the paper and pencil.

Atmosphere - Very pleasant and pretty. When you enter there’s a mini running waterfall to the left.

A decent soup dumpling place. I liked their appetizer options and the stir-fried noodles. Braised beef noodle soup is so so at best. Soup base is plain, while the noodles are factory made and basic at best.
It’s nice to see they also offer Asian breakfast items like soybean milk and crispy dough.

Just absolutely fantastic and delicious in every way. We come here before going to Citifield for a game. The soup dumplings are ridiculously delicious and the noodles and side dishes are equally sublime. The service was fast, efficient and prompt. Can not say enough about this Michelin rated amazing spot in Flushing...
